admissionRule: The profile gate requires a legally usable, source-supported native-xTB to TM/NIST charge-sign conversion and direct execution of the pinned NIST Hsieh averaging, partitioning, linear binning, and hydrogen-bond probability equations. Phase-topology and quantitative LLE validation remain separate gates.

molecularMethod.basisSet: GFN2-xTB parametrization; no orbital basis-set selection
molecularMethod.cavityRadii: CPCM-X 1.1.0 xTB element radii, retained in each .cosmo $coord_rad block
molecularMethod.tessellation: CPCM-X 1.1.0 ddCOSMO surface, retained per-segment in each .cosmo file
molecularMethod.referenceState: neutral isolated molecule with COSMO conductor boundary

conformers.selection: lowest converged MMFF94s energy; one conformer retained and then optimized with GFN2-xTB

surfaceAndConversion.surfaceFormat: CPCM-X .cosmo with atom, segment position, charge, area, charge density, and potential
surfaceAndConversion.converter: Project-authored conversion from retained CPCM-X/xTB native surface segments; CPCM-X-emitted bins are not copied
surfaceAndConversion.inputChargeConvention: xTB ddCOSMO native convention emitted by --cosmo
surfaceAndConversion.outputChargeConvention: xTB TM convention consumed directly by the pinned NIST converter
chargeSignEvidence: Exact licensed excerpts and upstream full-file hashes are retained under reference-source/ and verified byte-for-byte.
Pinned xTB src/solv/cosmo.f90 explicitly negates native zeta when tmcosmo is selected.
Pinned xTB src/xhelp.f90 states that --tmcosmo uses TM convention for written .cosmo files.
Pinned CPCM-X src/cpcmx/qc_calc.f90 invokes xTB --cosmo, not --tmcosmo.
Pinned NIST profiles/to_sigma.py consumes charge/area directly and applies the positive O/N/F acceptor mask.
segmentLevelAssertions: independent recomputation without importing the generator
surface and final profile area closure
surfaceAndConversion.volume: deterministic union of retained CPCM cavity spheres on a 0.05 angstrom midpoint grid

requiredAssertions: all six exact profiles load from the project-generated directory
activities change on at least two distinct compositions
profile grids, partition counts, area integrals, metadata identities, and hashes match the manifest

prohibitedInputs: profiles copied or transformed from a restricted database
mixed quantum methods across the six identities
